name: dynamic-background
description: Tints the editor background with the color of the symbols (strings, keywords, variables, types...) visible on screen, so each region of your code gets its own subtle visual identity.

commands.title: Dynamic Background: Reload Theme and Grammars

dynamicBackground.symbol.description: Symbol type whose foreground color is blended into the editor background.

dynamicBackground.intensity.description: Maximum weight of the symbol color in the blend. 0.1 = result stays 90% close to the theme's original background.

dynamicBackground.scaleByDensity.description: When enabled, the intensity is proportional to the amount of visible symbols (up to 'intensity'). When disabled, a single visible symbol applies the full intensity.

dynamicBackground.densitySaturation.description: With 'scaleByDensity', the fraction of visible text (non-whitespace characters) taken by the symbol at which the maximum intensity is reached. Below it, the intensity scales linearly.

dynamicBackground.debounceMs.description: Delay (ms) after scrolling before the color is recalculated.

dynamicBackground.maxTokenizeLines.description: Maximum number of lines tokenized per document (larger files tokenize only the visible area, possibly less accurately).
